intro.text: A scholar working under Navani Kholin in Urithiru.

items.text: Kristir was the head scholar on duty the day Navani tried Tomor's lift fabrial gauntlet, and won seven clearmarks in the scholars' betting pool on whether Navani would try it. Afterwards Navani asked her to put their best mathematicians to work on separating vertical and lateral movement in conjoined fabrials.
